title: Inter-Agent Message Envelope
description: Standard envelope for all communication between the Orchestrator and agents. Every message in Synapsis uses this schema. Large data payloads are not carried in messages — they are written to the Blackboard and referenced by key.

message_id.description: Unique identifier for this message. Generated by the sender. Used for correlation and debugging.

session_id.description: Session this message belongs to. All messages in a user conversation share the same session_id.

sender.description: Agent ID or component name that sent this message.

receiver.description: Agent ID or component name that should receive this message. The Orchestrator is the default routing target for results.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone when the message was created. Used for ordering and timeout detection.

message_type.description: Determines the schema of the payload field and how the receiver should process the message.

payload.description: Message-type-specific payload. Schema is determined by message_type. See message-protocol.md for per-type schemas.

correlation_id.description: Links related messages across multiple agents. All messages in a debate loop share one correlation_id. All messages for a specific task share another.

in_response_to.description: The message_id this message is directly responding to. Forms a reply chain for debugging.

priority.description: Processing priority. 'critical' messages (like timeouts and escalations) are processed before others.
